'''Kira Buckland''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. She is currently affiliated with CESD Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Kira Buckland was born on July 16, 1987 in Anchorage, Alaska.
